cards.acceptance: Edit mode binds and verifies the exact existing source identity, version, authenticated revision hash, and catalog revision; identity changes require an explicit fork operation.

cards.acceptance: Every Studio save attempt has a unique request ID and only its matching cancellation, result, or conflict may mutate that editor session.

cards.acceptance: A digest-addressed reusable staging target is accepted only when target and descendants are non-link/non-reparse, the complete regular-file set exactly equals editor_files, every byte matches, and no extra entry exists.

cards.finding: Reuse checks links only through the parent, compares declared files only, ignores undeclared extra files and descendant links, then reports the editor-derived digest/file count as if it described the actual target.
cards.next_action: bound backend admission by directory count, total entries, depth, file count, per-file bytes, and aggregate bytes before source admission; own hostile empty-directory breadth

cards.acceptance: The tree admitted and copied by the backend is cryptographically equal to the exact editor_files bytes the user approved, including after materialization and immediately before create.
cards.control_action: bind the exact editor-derived package digest through materialization, source admission, and immutable skill create
cards.finding: The host coordinator discards materialization treeSha256/fileCount, admits only source_directory, and never compares the backend admission tree to the approved editor digest.
cards.next_action: use an unambiguous cross-runtime length-framed tree commitment, enforce exact allowed-directory topology with no excluded injected entries, reject canonical path aliases, and require the admission receipt path/hash/count to equal the materializer receipt

cards.acceptance: Failure handling never follows a link or reparse point and moves temporary trees only into a verified Pacify-X-owned quarantine below the project root with a retained lifecycle receipt.
cards.control_action: make failed materialization quarantine link-safe, contained, registered, and reconciled
cards.finding: The error path creates and renames into .px/studio-inputs/.failed without checking that .failed is a non-link physical directory contained by the project.
cards.next_action: remove the race by retaining failed PX-owned resources at their already-contained original path or use an actually anchored move primitive; add a swap-window owner and immutable lifecycle receipt

cards.acceptance: Every editor_files path maps one-to-one to one portable regular file; case aliases, NTFS alternate streams, device names, trailing dot/space aliases, reserved components, and directory-case collisions fail before write, followed by exact post-write verification.

cards.finding: Logical paths are case-folded only as complete strings and permit colons, reserved device components, trailing dots/spaces, and differently cased directory prefixes; safeSegment also sanitizes distinct identities into the same physical segment.
